title: running-smoke-tests input
description: ADVISORY — documents the assembled stage input; the engine validates workflow input and stage OUTPUTS only (engine/validation.py). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage smoke-tests.

loop_back_feedback.description: engine-injected (conditional): reviewer findings threaded into a re-run after a loop_back.
